title: master->master warm reboot fails because of pending tasks in the queue
author: daall

**Description**
We see on some platforms that warm reboot fails the RESTARTCHECK due to pending tasks on ports that have been disabled in the system.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Configure a platform w/ 2 ports that are oper and admin down.
2. `sudo warm-reboot`

**Describe the results you received:**
```

RESTARTCHECK failed

Jan 26 23:50:19.013387 str2-7050cx3-acs-03 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck: Restart check result: NOT_READY
```

**Describe the results you expected:**

comments.body:
I looked at this issue today, and found out that the issue is not necessarily with the ports that are oper and admin down.
With minigraph.xml untouched, the warm-reboot fails at pausing OA:
```
root@str2-7050cx3-acs-01:/etc/sonic# sudo warm-reboot -vvv
Tue 26 Jan 2021 11:49:57 PM UTC Saving counters folder before warmboot...
Tue 26 Jan 2021 11:49:58 PM UTC Pausing orchagent ...
RESTARTCHECK failed
Tue 26 Jan 2021 11:49:59 PM UTC warm-reboot failure (10) cleanup ...
Tue 26 Jan 2021 11:49:59 PM UTC Cancel warm-reboot: code (1)
```

After making the below changes manually to the ports names, the RESTARTCHECK passes:

```
root@str2-7050cx3-acs-01:/etc/sonic# diff minigraph.xml.new minigraph.xml
980c980
<         <InterfaceName>Ethernet33/1</InterfaceName>
---
>           <InterfaceName>Ethernet33</InterfaceName>
993c993
<         <InterfaceName>Ethernet34/1</InterfaceName>
---
>           <InterfaceName>Ethernet34</InterfaceName>
```



comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body:
There is one issue in port_config.ini. One of the lanes (128) is shared between two ports (Ethernet124 and Ethernet132):
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/device/arista/x86_64-arista_7050cx3_32s/Arista-7050CX3-32S-C32/port_config.ini#L35

```
Ethernet124     125,126,127,128   Ethernet32/1  32
Ethernet128     129               Ethernet33    33
Ethernet132     128               Ethernet34    34
```

Apart from this, the show int status output seems to be incorrect - the speed for two 10G ports is set to 100G. The minigraph also has the speed incorrectly to 100G:
```
"Ethernet128": {
            "alias": "Ethernet33",
            "description": "Ethernet33",
            "fec": "rs",
            "index": "33",
            "lanes": "129",
            "mtu": "9100",
            "pfc_asym": "off",
            "speed": "100000"
        }
```
However, in the bcmsh, the ports speed look as expected (10G):
```
                 ena/        speed/ link auto    STP                  lrn  inter   max   cut   loop
           port  link  Lns   duplex scan neg?   state   pause  discrd ops   face frame  thru?  back
       xe0( 66)  !ena   1   10G  FD   SW  No   Forward          None   FA    XFI  9412    No      
       xe1(130)  !ena   1   10G  FD   SW  No   Forward          None   FA    XFI  9412    No  

```

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body:
RCA: 

1. port_config.ini does not have speed for this SKU - https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/device/arista/x86_64-arista_7050cx3_32s/Arista-7050CX3-32S-C32/port_config.ini#L35
2. This leads to `portspeed` dict being empty for this SKU during execution of port_alias.py - https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/library/port_alias.py#L181
3. This leads to using default value of `iface_speed` in the template of minigraph_device.j2 - https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/templates/minigraph_device.j2#L20
4. Finally, since the default value of `iface_speed` is set to 100G for this SKU (in internal testbed files), all the interfaces on this HWSKU gets the same speed of 100G.

However, I think that Orchagent/PortOrch detects the discrepancy between APP_DB and ASIC_DB and the SET action for this port remains a pending task.
This ultimately blocks the warm-reboot as the Orchagent RESTARTCHECK fails. With debug swss logs:

```
Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 DEBUG swss#orchagent: :- doPortTask: Set port Ethernet132 speed to 10000 -> 100000
Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 DEBUG swss#orchagent: :< doPortTask: exit

Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck: WarmRestart check found pending tasks:
Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck:     PORT_TABLE:Ethernet128|SET|alias:Ethernet33|description:Ethernet33|fec:rs|index:33|lanes:129|pfc_asym:off|speed:100000|mtu:9100|admin_status:down
Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck:     PORT_TABLE:Ethernet132|SET|alias:Ethernet34|description:Ethernet34|fec:rs|index:34|lanes:128|pfc_asym:off|speed:100000|mtu:9100|admin_status:down
Jan 29 22:14:23.146474 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- warmRestartCheck: Restart check result: NOT_READY
```

`port_config.ini` for HWSKU `Arista-7050CX3-32S-C32` has missing speed column and duplicated lanes.
The incorrect speed causes issues in Orchagent RESTARTCHECK as the below task remains as the remaining item during swss shutdown.

**- Why I did it**
Fixes: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6569

**- How I did it**
Updated port_config.ini file with speed, and removed duplicated lanes.

**- How to verify it**
Generated new minigraph, and installed it on a 7050CX3 device, the RESTARTCHECK passes and warm-reboot proceeds.
